notes: spec_copy is the subscription spec 3.3.0 copy, verbatim. Tests fail if it drifts.
Every price in this file must equal CAIRN_SUBSCRIPTION_PRICE_CENTS. The API refuses to start if they differ (UC-SUB-02).
draft_copy was written for the build because the spec doesn't supply it.

spec_copy.subscribe_prompt_body: Everything you've done is saved, and you can still see all of it. To keep adding and updating your tasks, you can subscribe.
spec_copy.read_only_banner: Your account is read-only. Everything is saved. You can subscribe any time to keep going.
spec_copy.terms_price: Cairn is $14.99 a month for your whole account, including all your cases.
spec_copy.terms_renewal: Your subscription renews automatically every month until you cancel. You'll be charged $14.99 today, and then $14.99 every month on the same day.
spec_copy.terms_renewal_early: Your subscription renews automatically every month until you cancel. Your first charge of $14.99 is on {trial_end_date}, when your free days end. After that, $14.99 every month on the same day.
spec_copy.terms_cancel: You can cancel any time in Settings, in as few steps as it took to subscribe. If you cancel, you won't be charged again, and you keep full access until the end of the month you've paid for. There are no refunds for any part of a month.
spec_copy.terms_includes: Your subscription includes every journey and task in Cairn. Downloading, closing, and deleting your information are always free.
spec_copy.terms_checkbox: I understand my subscription renews every month at $14.99 until I cancel.
spec_copy.terms_secure_note: You'll enter your payment details on a secure page from Stripe, our payment provider. Stripe will ask for your billing address so sales tax is handled correctly. Cairn never sees or stores your card number or address.
spec_copy.checkout_submit_text: Renews monthly at $14.99 until you cancel. Cancel any time in Cairn Settings.
spec_copy.finishing: Thank you. We're finishing setting up your subscription. This usually takes a few seconds.
spec_copy.finishing_slow: This is taking longer than usual. You don't need to pay again. We'll keep checking, and you can close this page if you need to.
spec_copy.success: You're subscribed. Everything in Cairn is open to you again. Your next payment of $14.99 is on {next_charge_date}. We're sending a confirmation with these details and how to cancel to {email}.
spec_copy.success_early: You're subscribed. You still have your free days. Your first payment of $14.99 is on {trial_end_date}. We're sending a confirmation with these details and how to cancel to {email}.
spec_copy.checkout_left: No problem. Nothing was charged. You can subscribe whenever you're ready.
spec_copy.payment_failed_inapp: We couldn't process your last payment. Everything stays open for now. You can update your payment details in Settings.
spec_copy.action_required_inapp: Your bank needs you to confirm your last payment. You can do that in Settings.
spec_copy.ended_read_only: Your subscription has ended. Everything you've done is saved, and you can still see it. You can subscribe again whenever you'd like.
spec_copy.settings_status_active: Subscribed. $14.99 a month. Next payment on {next_charge_date}.
spec_copy.settings_status_canceling: Canceled. You have full access until {period_end_date}. You won't be charged again.
spec_copy.settings_status_trial: Free days end on {trial_end_date}. No subscription yet.
spec_copy.settings_status_trial_subscribed: Subscribed. Your first payment of $14.99 is on {trial_end_date}.
spec_copy.settings_status_payment_issue: There's a problem with your last payment. Your account is still open.
spec_copy.settings_status_none: No subscription. Your account is read-only.
spec_copy.cancel_explainer: If you cancel, you won't be charged again. You'll keep full access until {period_end_date}. After that, your account becomes read-only. Nothing is deleted, and you can subscribe again any time. There are no refunds for any part of a month.
spec_copy.cancel_done: Your subscription is canceled. You won't be charged again. You have full access until {period_end_date}.
spec_copy.undo_cancel_done: Your subscription will continue. Your next payment of $14.99 is on {next_charge_date}.
spec_copy.delete_account_with_subscription: Deleting your account also cancels your subscription right away. You won't be charged again. There is no refund for the rest of this month.
spec_copy.annual_reminder_body: This is your yearly reminder that your Cairn subscription renews every month at $14.99. It covers your whole account. You can cancel any time in Cairn under Settings, then Subscription. Taking a break in Cairn doesn't pause your subscription.
spec_copy.price_change_subject: A change to your Cairn subscription price
spec_copy.price_change_body: Starting {effective_date}, your Cairn subscription will be {new_price} a month. Until then, nothing changes. You can cancel any time in Cairn under Settings, then Subscription.
spec_copy.new_journey_needs_subscription: To start a new journey, you'll need a subscription. It's $14.99 a month for all your cases. Your draft is saved either way.
spec_copy.terms_tax: Any sales tax is included in the $14.99.
spec_copy.terms_breaks: Taking a break in Cairn doesn't pause your subscription or change what you pay. Breaks are just for you, to step back and rest.
spec_copy.settings_breaks_note: Taking a break doesn't pause or change your subscription.

draft_copy.payments_unavailable: Payments aren't working right now. Nothing was charged. You can try again in a little while.
draft_copy.cancel_failed: Your cancellation didn't go through yet. Nothing more will be charged because of the delay. I'll keep trying.
draft_copy.already_subscribed: You're already subscribed. Here's your subscription.
draft_copy.not_now_billing: Let's leave that for now. It will be here whenever you're ready.
draft_copy.delete_cancel_failed: I couldn't cancel your subscription just now, so your account hasn't been deleted yet. Nothing more will be charged because of the delay. Please try again in a few minutes.
draft_copy.email_subscription_started: You're subscribed to Cairn. It's $14.99 a month for your whole account and renews every month until you cancel. You can cancel any time in Cairn under Settings, then Subscription. There are no refunds for any part of a month.
draft_copy.email_subscription_canceled: Your Cairn subscription is canceled, as you asked. You won't be charged again. You keep full access until the end of the month you've paid for.
draft_copy.settings_status_not_started: Your 28 free days begin when you start your first journey. No subscription yet.
